text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Professor Mark Brincat, head of the Malta medical school, says he is discussing the possible setting up of a second offshore medical school in collaboration with Yale University. The school would be open to foreigners as well as Maltese.
- Opposition Nationalist Party council to meet later this week to set policies.
- Minibus owners increase prices following fuel costs increase.
- Police search for possible illegal immigrants after launch runs aground.
